adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, `calendarReference` was changed to an array via `.filter(...)` and updates now iterate `for (const reference of calendarReference)` to update all `_calendar` references. However, in the reschedule-merge branch (`if (newBookingId)`), the code still deletes the old calendar event using `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))`, which selects only the first matching reference. With multiple `_calendar` references (e.g., collective/co-host calendars after `destinationCalendar` became an array), this would leave additional old calendar events undeleted (orphaned).
